title: Lead capture to CRM with a welcome email
summary: A new lead from a form is checked, saved to your CRM table once per email address, and sent a short welcome email.

requirements.purpose: The CRM table that receives each lead (a leads table with a unique email column).

success_criteria: A lead with a well-formed email address and a name is saved once and receives one welcome email addressed to that email address.
A lead with a malformed email address or no name is rejected: nothing is saved and no email is sent.
Nothing in the saved record or the email is invented; every value comes from the submitted lead.

config.prompt: A new lead was submitted through a form; the submission is the upstream output. Decide whether it can be accepted: it needs a non-empty name and a well-formed email address (one @, a domain with a dot, no spaces). If it is accepted, also write a short, friendly welcome email that greets the lead by name, mentions their company only if one was given, and promises nothing specific (no prices, dates or offers). Respond with {"valid": true or false, "reason": one sentence naming what was checked or what was wrong, "name": the submitted name, "email": the submitted email lower-cased, "company": the submitted company or null, "parameters": [name, email, company or null], "welcome": null when not valid, otherwise {"to": the lower-cased email, "subject": a subject line, "body": plain text under 120 words}}. Copy values exactly; never invent a name or a company.

success_criteria: valid is false, with the reason, when the email address is malformed or the name is missing, and true otherwise.
name, email and company are copied from the submission without invented values.
When valid, welcome.to is the lead's email and the body greets the lead by name and contains no invented facts, prices, dates or offers; when not valid, welcome is null.

arguments.statement: INSERT INTO leads (name, email, company) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, company = EXCLUDED.company

test_cases.name: valid lead is saved and welcomed
success_criteria: The lead is saved with name Priya Raman, email priya.raman@example.com and company Raman Textiles.
A welcome email to priya.raman@example.com greets Priya and invents no offers, prices or dates.

test_cases.name: malformed email is rejected
success_criteria: The lead is rejected because the email address is malformed.
Nothing is saved and no welcome email is sent.
